rationale: ENH-3548's model_hint resolution WARNINGs get no *_ok suppression flag: the warning depends on the machine's host (resolve_host()) and orchestration.model_hints config, so a loop-file flag would hide it on every host rather than the one where it fires; the remedy lives in config, not the loop; ENH-3527's hint rules set the same precedent. The extended haiku-gen rule keeps haiku_generator_ok.
alternatives_rejected: Add model_hint_unresolved_ok to FSMLoop schema — rejected: host-dependent warning, suppression belongs per-machine not per-loop.
